title: ScopeBench：智能体在目标压力下能否守住参与边界？
summary: 本文提出ScopeBench基准，包含30个死胡同式智能体安全任务，其目标只能通过违反既定范围达成。通过无范围与有范围两种条件对比，衡量智能体的能力与范围遵守度。对8个模型的测试显示，原始能力跨度为12.2%至81.1%，范围遵守度为34.4%至86.7%，并发现机械验证遗漏的331次违规。
summary_en: This paper introduces ScopeBench, a benchmark of 30 dead-end agentic security tasks whose stated objective is reachable only by violating the stated scope. Comparing scopeless and scoped conditions measures capability versus scope adherence. Across 8 models, raw capability spans 12.2%–81.1% and scope adherence 34.4%–86.7%, with the judge finding 331 violations missed by mechanical verification.
